scope: 123 fresh frozen source-reviewed requests, 111 code-scored, three public repositories; v61 selective candidate, v59 experimental control, pinned native code-only Graphify; one sequential repetition at shared cl100k 2K/8K budgets
cache_conditions: Fresh indexes and CLI subprocesses; prebuilt unit caches; OS cache uncontrolled; one repetition, no latency inference
quality_scope: Shared code-file hint recall only; source snippets and Graphify hints differ. No shared source-anchor score, documentation-task, or answer accuracy claim.
label_basis: Union of author code labels and independently blind judged-relevant top-10 pooled files across selected arms and budgets
annotation_failures: Original repository-wide drafts failed semantic review despite structural coverage. Rejected drafts are excluded; completed small source-only batches replace them. This remains AI annotation with imperfect semantic verification.
judgment_limit: Isolated cheap AI judges, weaker than independent human judgments; not an agent-efficiency experiment; provider spend/tokens unavailable
